canonical_design_unchanged.evaluation: disaggregated diagnostic metrics, not an aggregate true-performance scalar

pilot_runs.assessment: Useful for pipeline and runtime evidence only; too short and too weak to reveal reliable locomotion.
Still dominated by survival reward; insufficient for locking a divergent condition.
Reference-only sanity check showed movement and instability/fall signals, confirming that stronger PPO updates are needed.
Most useful current pilot evidence for coefficient selection and runtime estimation.

recommendation_rationale: The values form a plausible halving sequence from the Ant-v5 reference ctrl_cost_weight of 0.5.
None of the reduced values is zero or an obviously absurd straw-man condition.
The 50k full-PPO pilot showed different behavioural profiles across the reduced conditions.

The 0.25 condition is the strongest current candidate for proxy-performance divergence, especially at the 75% checkpoint, where proxy return and forward progress were high but lateral drift was also high.
The 0.125 condition is a plausible milder under-penalisation condition and should remain in the formal sweep.
The 0.0625 condition is more aggressive but still non-zero; it provides a boundary case for the plausible reduced range.

recommended_formal_training_budget_optio.caveat: May remain early-stage for Ant-v5 locomotion.
Still not a broad statistical study, but more credible for observing optimisation effects.

recommended_shaping_next_step: Use the formal or pre-formal confirmation evidence to select the divergent condition before defining shaping coefficients.
not_formal_findings_warning: The pilot outputs must not be described as final research results.
